lead.title: 01 总工与集成
lead.responsibility: Shared interfaces/contracts, dependencies, root/CI decisions, task sequencing and final Windows/macOS integration.

backend.title: 02 数据与后台
backend.responsibility: Shared services, source archives, synchronization and budgets for desktop clients; sole database migration owner.

learning.title: 03 学习与记忆
learning.responsibility: Shared learning, memory, model adapters, teaching/disclosure and learning-quality evidence for both desktop clients.

ios.title: 04 iPad 原生体验
ios.responsibility: macOS native product in apps/macos; preserve/defer apps/ios and mobile dirty work, checkpoints and complete goals. Runtime alias/title/branch remain unchanged.

web.title: 05 Safari 与桌面端
web.responsibility: Windows product in apps/windows; retain apps/safari-extension and web experience. Runtime identity remains unchanged.

qa.title: 06 独立验收
qa.responsibility: Independent Windows and macOS acceptance with separate per-OS evidence; preserve deferred mobile cases.

support.title: 07 疑难排障与技术研究
support.responsibility: On-demand bounded desktop build/package/permission-path research; root patches only by explicit delegation, application fixes stay with owners.

routing: lead <-> each worker; runtime opaque route IDs are authoritative
responsibility_policy: Descriptive desktop-first ownership only; editing this file does not reconfigure identities, routes, worktrees, branches, models, effort or permissions. One active and at most one next task per owner; no overlapping platform files.
